stem.en: In a Special Intensive Revision, which of these is NOT a ground for deleting a name from the electoral roll?

text.en: The voter has died since the last roll.
The voter has moved to another place.
The voter is enrolled twice by mistake.
The voter did not vote last time.

explanation.en: The four grounds are death of the voter, change of residence, duplicate enrolment and being permanently untraceable. Not voting at the last election is not one of them.

hints.en: There are four grounds. Check each option against them.
Does the roll list people who may vote, or people who did vote?
